name: Styria
summary: Two horizontal bands of white over green. The colours come from the Styrian arms: a white, horned, fire-breathing panther on green.
origin: The panther has been the arms of Styria since the 12th century, under the Otakar dukes. The white-green flag has been used since the 19th century.
facts: Styria is called 'the green heart of Austria' for its forests.
clues: White over green, two horizontal bands.
Its colours come from a fire-breathing panther.
